hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *frontend/src/*.ts|*frontend/src/*.tsx) export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"; cd /Applications/RugManufactureCustomApp/frontend && npx tsc --noEmit ;; esac; }; true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *backend/app/*.py|*backend/migrate_*.py) cd /Applications/RugManufactureCustomApp/backend && source venv/bin/activate && python3 -m py_compile "$f" ;; esac; }; true
